purpose.objective: Independently verify source-qualified academy state/query and final consumer workflow closure with adversarial synthetic evidence at exact revisions.
successCriteria: VER-01 specifies independent adversarial checks for all seven internal workflows, exact edition/attempt/occurrence identity, teacher-final scope, cancellation/replacement and unknown currentness.
VER-02 qualifies exact DOM-02/QRY-02 and checks early domain/query parity; it does not claim final consumer routing verified.
VER-03 follows exact CON-03 and checks final teacher HTTP/web, Workbench MCP/report and month-end application/source/web closure, retaining failed/unrun scopes explicitly.
Verification binds producer revisions/result hashes, actual changed production paths and meaningful negative cases; source success is distinct from native activation and teacher acceptance.
inScope: Dedicated synthetic workflow checks and metadata-only verification coverage graphs.
Exact producer-source validation and independent source review; no business implementation edits.
outOfScope: No publication, merge, deploy, native activation, real student source reads/writes, printing/sending or parent communication.
No common contracts/dependency pins/permissions, native config/credentials/services or unrelated Work changes.
No math/research meaning, teacher final-item selection or state inference implementation changed.
